question: When showing a directory structure, how do I emphasize certain files and add explanatory notes? Can I do both at the same time? Does this work on directories too or only individual files?
ground_truth: You can make files or folders stand out using two properties that work together: 1) The `highlighted` property adds an accent background color for visual emphasis, and 2) The `comment` property adds explanatory text that appears next to the item name. You can use both properties on the same file or folder simultaneously. For example: `<File name="README.md" highlighted comment="Must be updated with your project details" />` will both highlight the README.md file with a background color AND add the explanatory comment next to it. These properties work on both individual files (using `<File>`) and folders (using `<Folder>`), giving you flexibility to emphasize entire directories or specific configuration files. This is similar to how code blocks support line highlighting and inline comments, but for file/folder structures.
